title: Why Is It So Hard to Overtake in Mexico?
description:
Hamilton was 10 km/h faster than Verstappen at the end of the main straight in the final laps of the 2026 Mexico City GP, and still lost by 0.799 seconds. Three reasons it is so hard to pass here: thin air, electric power that fades early, and a battery that refills easily.
